text_block_list.text:
As I was passing by, I happened to 
overhear an Umamusume talking to herself. 
At that moment—

"This idea might actually be useful for 
training with Katsuragi Ace!"
“—Hey, Trainer. How are you doing that?”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that face says you don't even know 
where to begin explaining. In that 
case—I'll just find out for myself.

...No, let's look at it the other way 
around. This is a good opportunity to 
observe Katsuragi Ace instead. That way, I 
can find something useful for my own 
races—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Thanks to you, I know how to 
prepare my mindset. All that's left is 
putting it into practice! And also—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
The way your thoughts sometimes spill out 
when you're focused—I love how honest you 
are!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, equipment check complete. 
Thorough management truly is the key to 
long-term operation—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Long-term "maintenance," huh? That doesn't 
just apply to equipment, does it? It 
applies to us, too...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ha! I see, so this is inspiration...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
He was always thinking about racing! No 
wonder everything looks like a racing hint 
to him. So that's the secret, huh?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Now that that's settled, let's go 
do a lap around the academy and look 
around!

Having taken the lesson to heart, 
Katsuragi Ace's running gained a 
remarkable polish from that day forward!
